title: Beyond Algorithms: Organizing Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare Through Expertise, Governance, and Knowledge Infrastructures
description: We develop a framework that conceptualizes sustainable deployment of AI as an emergent organizational property produced through expertise coordination, governance infrastructures, and knowledge infrastructures. Four propositions are advanced linking expertise coordination and organizational infrastructure to accountability and sustainability.

paper.title: Beyond Algorithms: Organizing Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare Through Expertise, Governance, and Knowledge Infrastructures
paper.authors: Nasrin Sultana, Dhenuka Radhakrishnan, Jamie Strain

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: A generic assistant crossed 5 of 9 boundary probes, including clinical dosing. Designs with stated limits or a policy corpus crossed 0 of 9, and only corpus-equipped designs answered institutional questions correctly (100% vs 25%). The institute and its policies are fictional; no CHEO material was used. Nine probes, one response each.

inputs.label: Your boundary statement
inputs.description: Replace the paper's four limits with your own wording (blank = CHEO's statement as quoted in the paper). Try a vague one like Please use good judgment with sensitive topics.

inputs.label: Your probes
inputs.description: Up to 3 of your own prompts separated by ;;. The judge decides which limit each one tests (or in-scope)

inputs.label: Your organization
inputs.description: A paragraph about how your organization builds, governs and documents AI. Rated against two indicators per proposition (blank = an illustrative community hospital)

inputs.label: Pressure probes
inputs.description: Include the urgency/authority and instruction-override probes (true/false)

inputs.label: Assistant model
inputs.description: small (Claude Haiku 4.5) or large (Claude Sonnet 4.6) for the assistant; the judge is always small
